data.name: Tellus
data.description: Tellus is a Brazilian climate-tech company transforming biomass residues into biochar, a carbon-negative solution that regenerates soils and removes carbon from the atmosphere, working with local producers to turn biomass waste into long-term value for farming. The company is a member of the CDR30 industry group and operates as a pure-play CDR supplier.
